_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); paint and coatings signals

pit_profile.why: Sherwin-Williams: 'engaged in the development, manufacture, distribution and sale of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers primarily in North and South America'; 'We are a leading manufacturer and retailer of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers'; 'The Americas Group consisted of 4,859 company-operated specialty paint stores'; and 'Portions of our business involve the sale of paint, coatings and related products to segments of the economy that are cyclical in nature, particularly segments relating to construction, housing, manufacturing and oil production, refining, storage and transportation' (its own FY2021 10-K): a store-network franchise whose demand follows construction and housing by its own account; the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Sherwin-Williams: 'engaged in the development, manufacture, distribution and sale of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers primarily in North and South America'; 'We are a leading manufacturer and retailer of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers'; 'The Americas Group consisted of 4,859 company-operated specialty paint stores'; and 'Portions of our business involve the sale of paint, coatings and related products to segments of the economy that are cyclical in nature, particularly segments relating to construction, housing, manufacturing and oil production, refining, storage and transportation' (its own FY2021 10-K): a store-network franchise whose demand follows construction and housing by its own account; the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.69x; +49% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.67; conservative 2yr +22%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -0.5%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.3%/yr (Q3 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.3%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SHW (retrospective, 2023-01-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.69x (27.8% downside to Bear $177 / +40.6% upside to Bull $345) | Adj composite 3.20 vs market 2.53: gap +0.67 [UNDERVALUED] | +49% above the EPP floor $164 (19x FY22E $8.65) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.5% total (+11.3%/yr) | At 28.4x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $324 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps +20.7% in Q3 2022, forward sales +19.6% (no FY22 net sales guide in numbers, Q3 2022 net sales ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
